# massdriver_service_account (Resource)

A Massdriver service account — a non-human identity for CI/CD pipelines, scripts, and other API clients. The platform issues one access token when the service account is created; it is exposed as the sensitive `token` attribute and cannot be retrieved again. To rotate the token, replace the resource (e.g., `terraform apply -replace`, or `replace_triggered_by` on a `time_rotating`). A new service account has no permissions until it is added to a group with `massdriver_service_account_group_membership`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A non-human identity for CI/CD and other API clients. The platform issues
# one token at creation, exposed as the sensitive `token` attribute.
resource "massdriver_service_account" "ci" {
  name                     = "ci-deployer"
  description              = "GitHub Actions deployer"
  token_expiration_minutes = 525600 # 1 year
}

# The token can't be re-fetched or re-issued in place, so rotate it by
# replacing the service account — here, automatically every 90 days.
resource "time_rotating" "ci_token" {
  rotation_days = 90
}

resource "massdriver_service_account" "rotated" {
  name                     = "ci-deployer-rotated"
  token_expiration_minutes = 60 * 24 * 100 # outlives the rotation window

  lifecycle {
    replace_triggered_by = [time_rotating.ci_token]
  }
}

output "ci_token" {
  value     = massdriver_service_account.ci.token
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable name, shown in the UI, logs, and audit trail.
- `token_expiration_minutes` (Number) How long the token issued at creation stays valid, in minutes. Max 5,256,000 (10 years). Changing it replaces the service account, issuing a new token. Ignored after import, since the platform doesn't report it.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description of what the service account is used for. When unset, drift on this field (e.g., a console edit) is ignored.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The service account's bearer token. Only available on the resource that created the service account; empty after import.
- `token_id` (String) ID of the token issued at creation. Empty after import.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The token is only returned at creation, so an imported service account has
# an empty `token`.
terraform import massdriver_service_account.ci <service_account_id>
```
